Is it really free?
Yes. Playing is free and there is nothing to buy on the site. Short ads inside the games pay the developers and the site.
Do I need to make an account?
No. There is no account and no newsletter, so you can open a game and start playing.
Do I have to download or install anything?
No. The games run instantly in your browser, with no download and no install.
Can I play on my phone or tablet?

Yes, for many games. Those made for touch are collected in the Mobile category, and games built for a wide screen will ask you to turn your phone sideways. A few older games need a keyboard and mouse, and they say so on their page.
Is the site safe for children?
The site only allows family-friendly games: no adult content, no gambling and no hate. Games for younger players are in the Kids category.
Will my progress and favourites be saved?

Your recently played games, favourites and light or dark choice are kept in your own browser and never leave your device. Most games also save their own progress the same way. The limitation is that clearing your browser data or using private mode will lose them.
A game will not load. What can I do?
If it still will not start, email us at contact@ilovewebgames.com and tell us which game it was. A real person will read your message.
Where do the games come from?

Six games are made by Door 404, the studio that runs the site. The rest are licensed from the Playgama, GameMonetize and GamePix networks, plus 14 sent in directly by independent developers. We never copy games from other portals.
How do I submit my own game?

Go to https://ilovewebgames.com/submit-game/. It is free and non-exclusive, and a real person plays every submission. If it is accepted, your game gets its own page that credits you and links back to you.
Can I have my game removed?
Yes, at any time. Accepted games stay hosted on your own server, so just email us at contact@ilovewebgames.com and we will take it down.
Can I embed a game on my own website?
Only the site's own games, which have an "Embed this game" box with ready-made code on their page. Games from other developers are not ours to licence.
How do I reach a real person?
Email contact@ilovewebgames.com. The site is run by Door 404, an escape room and game studio from Novi Sad, Serbia.
